claims: 5 is the natural number following 4 and preceding 6.
5 represents a cardinal value of five units.
A human hand has five fingers.
The only divisors of 5 are 1 and 5.
The five senses are sight, sound, smell, taste, touch.
The English alphabet has five vowels.
A "fiver" is commonly used in Britain to refer to a five-pound note.
The digit "5" is typically written with a line across, a small line down, and a curve.
There are five Pillars of Islam
